study: Stateful conformance obligations under partial robot-policy interface evidence
research_questions: Does a contract-compiled distinguishing suite improve detection or observability over equal-budget manual/random probes and strong stateful replay?
Which incremental benefits, if any, come from independent authority, temporal state, provenance and generated witnesses?
How much public integration evidence supports a grounded verdict, and where must the tool abstain?
Can real historical integration failures and intended legacy conventions be reproduced without trained-weight inference?
family_rule: Do not count framework versions or normalization variants as independent policy families
inventory_status: Not fixed; no final research dataset or evaluation exists

split_rules.existing_examples: development-only, including all derived copies and previous public-checkpoint evidence
split_rules.previously_inspected_incidents: retrospective/development case studies, not blinded holdout
split_rules.group: framework + policy family + checkpoint lineage + embodiment + adapter path
split_rules.dependency_clusters: Shared checkpoints, source fixes and root causes remain in one cluster across variants
split_rules.held_out: Fix integration identities, checkpoint lineages and mutation-composition families before final runs
split_rules.leakage: No tuning on final outcomes; changes after evaluation require a versioned amended protocol and honest disclosure

labels.confirmed_incident: Pinned source reproduction plus independent authoritative intended convention and provenance
labels.reported_incident: External issue report or proposed fix without enough ground truth; separate from confirmed detection denominator
labels.injected_fault: Explicit intervention into an executed real framework path, never relabeled historical
labels.correct_control: Grounded intended convention, including checkpoint-specific legacy behavior
labels.insufficient_evidence: Authority or observations deliberately/naturally missing; UNKNOWN expected unless another grounded obligation fails

metrics.detection: FAIL / all labeled incompatible cases; UNKNOWN remains a nondetection
metrics.coverage: Separate PASS, FAIL and UNKNOWN rates with exact denominators and erased/missing fields
metrics.witness: Offline and real-adapter replay success, retained queries/events, reduction cost
metrics.effort: Actual setup/configuration artifacts and measured time where observable; no invented human-study times
metrics.cost: Wall time, peak worker RSS, queries and cold/warm startup separately
metrics.uncertainty: Paired integration/root-cause clustered summaries; no mutation-level pseudoreplication or deployment-prevalence precision claims

baselines: Native framework checks with their actual applicable scope
Existing v0.1 MLTools independent stateful checker
ExecSpec-style normalization certificate, faithfully scoped and labeled if reimplemented
Applicable Policy Space/Tether/preflight/XPolicyLab workflows or explicit unavailability limits
Applicable robotruth manifest comparison and ActionABI finite-grammar audit, with source-verified scope and equal evidence

resource_plan.status: development limits, must be finalized in freeze
resource_plan.hardware: local CPU only; no paid compute or robot control
resource_plan.weights: excluded unless separately justified and explicitly permitted in an amended plan
resource_plan.dependency_installation: separate pinned CPU environments; dependency downloads recorded separately from benchmark metadata

freeze_gate: Actual second-framework transform imports and CPU execution verified
Inventory meets required frameworks/families/embodiments with truthful authority labels
Source revisions, licenses, cluster identities, split manifest and intervention recipes fixed
Development-only tolerances, seeds, run counts and analysis code fixed
Every baseline and ablation has an equal-evidence input contract and declared applicability
Commit protocol and inventory hashes before any final evaluation
publication_constraints: No paper result numbers before actual final runs
No task-success or safety claim from processor probes
Unavailable or inapplicable baselines are limitations, not wins
Public release, outreach, submission and paid compute require approval
